review_evidence: Independent review verifies the initial tracking fetch and the local target update check executable reference hooks before mutation. Checked-out delivery retains protected branch, signature, index and collision checks. The private ref writer uses isolated hooks.
verified_behaviors: The native local Git synchronization fixture advances an unchecked ref with an installed dormant pre-commit hook. An executable reference hook blocks the first tracking fetch without updating either ref. Checked targets preserve unaffected edits and reject relevant executable index hooks before private setup.
